title: DMR - Death Rally (1996) Inspired postapocalyptic driving game | Alpha gameplay
author: VegetableTour1920

comments.author: VegetableTour1920
comments.body:
I'm trying to polish the gameplay to have demo on steam hopefully this month. It's already fun and multiplayer (or split screen) works well, but trying to nail the gameplay on the cut content.
A bit more info on game here, sorry about the cringe tryhard marketing speech. Did not have time to tune it down yet (ChatGPT). Graphics have also improved since the vids and photos taken [https://playdmr.com/](https://playdmr.com/)

comments.author: count023
comments.body: oh man, it's been so long since i played the original death rally, i remember it just being top down like gta1, with teh spike bumpers

replies.author: VegetableTour1920
replies.body: Yeah, it was top down. There is piston spikes you can fit in the front gun slot. It will push the other car hard, it depends on the weight of your and opponent car how much - smaller cars will go flying. There are a lot of physics based weapons so there is balance having bigger heavier car and smaller nimbler one.

comments.author: Hour_Disk_1209
comments.body: I like it but a game like that should be played on phone too

replies.author: VegetableTour1920
replies.body:
I have been keeping mobile in mind from the get go. This is on high settings on PC, on low settings it runs on phone also (obviously it will not look as nice). It was running 30-50fps on Retroid Pocket 5, no specific optimization for phone yet.

I haven't tried the web build yet, but to my understanding it should be possible (Godot 4.7.2 C#).

comments.author: Capybarhigh
comments.body:
Looking nice!

How did you do those nice tire tracks in the sand? They look great!

replies.author: VegetableTour1920
replies.body: I give all credit to Opus, a few hours of back and forth and it's great. I have it in debug options that if the tire tracks affect physics or not, it works well but it has performance cost and on multiplayer + online ranked time challenges I'm leaning on setting them default off
